record_title: Second-order tail trichotomy for weighted porous-medium self-similarity
provenance: A source-specific far-field refinement of the bounded self-similar profiles classified in arXiv:2609.20397v1. The common leading weighted-absorption tail is sharpened to a three-regime second-order expansion separated by the resonance m=2p-1.
limitations: The theorem concerns far-field asymptotics of the bounded self-similar profiles covered by the source classification. It does not establish PDE stability or attraction, and the harmonic-cancellation case can require a higher-order expansion. Older homogeneous absorption literature was not exhaustively inspected, so originality is claimed only for the explicit weighted source-specific trichotomy and coefficients.
